records.context: The Hits button: build the results panel in steps, then open.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression.HitsOpener.press#0
records.source: The Hits button: build the results panel in steps, then open.
records.translation: Hits 버튼: 결과 패널을 단계적으로 구성한 다음 엽니다.

records.context: The first press used to build the application view's whole results panel in one go, a freeze of over a second. It is now built one step per event-loop turn (see ``AppScreen._build_owed_part_in_steps``) and the tab is brought to the front when construction is finished. With the panel built, or on an application view that defers nothing, this is :meth:`open`.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression.HitsOpener.press#1
records.source: The first press used to build the screen's whole results panel in one go, a freeze of over a second. It is now built one step per event-loop turn (see ``AppScreen._build_owed_part_in_steps``) and the tab is raised when it is finished. With the panel built, or on a screen that defers nothing, this is :meth:`open`.
records.translation: 이전에는 버튼을 처음 누르면 화면의 전체 결과 패널을 한꺼번에 구성하여 인터페이스가 1초 넘게 멈췄습니다. 이제는 이벤트 루프가 한 번 돌 때마다 한 단계씩 구성하고(``AppScreen._build_owed_part_in_steps`` 참조), 완료되면 탭을 앞으로 가져옵니다. 패널이 이미 구성되어 있거나 화면에서 미루는 작업이 없으면 :meth:`open` 을 호출합니다.

records.context: The panel is read only if it has been built. Building it here, for a page that finds no run in a panel that was never shown, froze the first Volcano Explorer page for most of a second.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression.open_publication_figure#1
records.source: The panel is read only if it has been built. Building it here, for a page that finds no run in a panel that was never shown, froze the first Volcano Explorer page for most of a second.
records.translation: 패널은 이미 구성된 경우에만 읽습니다. 한 번도 표시되지 않은 패널에서 실행 기록을 찾지 못한 페이지를 위해 여기서 패널을 구성하면, 첫 Volcano Explorer 페이지가 거의 1초 동안 멈추곤 했습니다.
